scope: Recompute and apply each live split velocity slot's warmstart from its constraint
tolerance_reason: f32 arithmetic with target-dependent contraction; ordered accumulation compared after three dispatches. Identities, padding, copied fields and reset constants remain exact.
preconditions: Native Rust layouts, bounded cumulative adjacency and index indirections, matching cache body tags or split velocity slots
Finite active arithmetic inputs; unit contact frames; 0..4 active points; coefficient in [0,1]
Runtime batch counts, buckets and hub capacities fit supplied buffers; each output body/slot has one writer
invariants: Adjacency traversal order is unchanged; ordinary gather reads cached deltas, split slots recompute point deltas
Only active impulse/cache/reset fields or selected velocity components change; all other words stay bitwise unchanged
Split hub bodies are skipped by ordinary gather and live slots are min(requested, capacity)
Twist mass and active geometry remain bitwise unchanged; inactive compact vectors and friction padding reset exactly during scale writeback.
outside_scope: Production solver scheduling and simulation scenes
